messages:
Lina (People Ops): FYI team — Samir Patel handed in his resignation this AM. Last day set for 2025-05-02 (Fri). Need quick coord: benefits/COBRA notice, final pay + expense cutoff, visa sponsorship wrap (he's on OPT), device return, SSO/badge offboarding, and an exit interview. Tagging owners: @Hannah @Chris @Raj.
Samir Patel: Thanks everyone. I'll tidy up my tickets and leave an ownership doc in the repo. Happy to return the laptop by mail or drop at SF office.
Chris (IT): I can arrange prepaid ship label for a MacBook. Plan: provide label on 2025-05-03 AM, pickup window 05/04-05/06. Tentative access removal schedule on last day: disable admin roles 17:00 PT, revoke API keys 18:00 PT, deactivate SSO at 18:15 PT.
Chris (IT): Quick command I'll run for token cleanup:
```
# list and disable tokens
gcloud iam service-accounts keys list --iam-account=samir@redwood
gcloud iam service-accounts keys disable <KEY_ID>
```
Hannah (Payroll): Benefits will terminate 05/02. COBRA packet gets emailed automatically but I'll manually initiate the enrollment packet for foreign addresses by 2025-05-09. Expense cutoff for final pay: 2025-04-30 EOD.
Samir Patel: I have one expense (~$120) from client dinner. I'll upload by today. Also question: will the company continue the commuter pre-tax deductions through last paycheck?
Hannah (Payroll): Commuter deductions stop on the last active payroll period. I'll confirm whether any prorated commuter credit remains; reply by 2025-04-15.
Raj (Security): Badge/SFO access will be disabled 05/02 18:00 PT. Facilities will hold mail for one week and accept device drop-offs if Samir wants in-person return.
Lina (People Ops): Immigration note: Samir is on OPT with company E-Verify implications. We must notify immigration counsel and send the standard sponsorship termination letter. @Samir please confirm forwarding address for the termination docs.
Immigration-Bot: Reminder: notify counsel within 7 business days of resignation for sponsored employees.
Samir Patel: My forwarding address is in my HR profile; will DM if needed. Also, need to confirm final pay date and whether accrued vacation will be paid out.
Hannah (Payroll): Accrued vacation payout policy depends on state law; for CA we payout unused paid time off on final paycheck. Final pay run is scheduled for 2025-05-09.
Lina (People Ops): Exit interview options: 05/01 11:00 PT (30m) or 05/02 10:30 PT (short). Samir, which works?
Samir Patel: 05/01 11:00 PT works.
Chris (IT): I'll post the UPS label and instructions once booked. Also verify any personal laptop keys or registered SSH keys to scrub from servers. Samir, please remove any personal SSH keys from ~/.ssh/authorized_keys by 05/02 or send list to me.
Samir Patel: Will remove the keys and send a short note when done.
Lina (People Ops): Owners & deadlines recap: Hannah 14 COBRA packet + final pay confirmation (by 2025-04-15). Chris 14 device ship label + cloud key revocation (by 2025-05-03/05-02 for revokes). Raj 14 badge deactivation & facilities hold (05/02). Samir 14 submit expenses + confirm address + remove keys (by 2025-04-30). I'll run the exit interview on 05/01 11:00 PT and mark checklist complete after payroll confirmation. :thumbsup:
Hannah (Payroll): :ok_hand: I'll update when COBRA packet is sent and confirm commute deduction question.
Chris (IT): :thumbsup: will DM tracking once label created.
Samir Patel: Thanks all 10 I'll upload receipts and confirm shipping preference today.
Lina (People Ops): Thanks team — flag anything that needs escalation here and I'll loop in legal/immigration if needed.
